'''Lokoko''' (Japanese: '''ロココ''' ''Rokoko'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP232|Just Waiting On A Friend]]''.

Lokoko lived in a mansion with a {{p|Ninetales}}. {{an|Brock}} fell in love with her, and was considering living with her forever. However, {{Ash}} and {{an|Misty}} felt that something was odd. Whenever Lokoko went by a mirror, she had no reflection, and whenever they tried to alert Brock to what was happening, Lokoko and Ninetales would get in their way.

After finding an old room in the mansion, they learned that the Ninetales belonged to the owner of the mansion. He left one day two hundred years before, and never returned. Lokoko was an illusion created by the Ninetales.

After a {{pkmn|battle}} with {{TRT}}, Brock learned the truth about Lokoko and Ninetales. The reason they wanted him to stay was due to his resemblance to the mansion's owner. After Ninetales's [[Poké Ball]] was broken in battle, Brock told it to go free. Once it did, the mansion and Lokoko disappeared.
